flashcard_questions.q: Which 1963 book described 'the problem that has no name'?
How many copies did The Feminine Mystique sell?
Which 1963 law made it illegal to pay men and women differently for the same work?
By 1973, how much did women earn for every dollar earned by men?
Which part of the 1964 Civil Rights Act banned employment discrimination on grounds of sex?
Which federal body was created to handle discrimination complaints under that Act?
Which organisation did Betty Friedan help found in 1966?
Who co-founded Ms. magazine in January 1972?
Which 1971 Supreme Court case first struck down a law for sex discrimination?
Which 1972 law banned sex discrimination in federally funded education?
Which 1973 Supreme Court ruling gave women a constitutional right to early abortion?
Who led the STOP ERA campaign against the Equal Rights Amendment?
The Equal Rights Amendment stalled at ____ states, three short of the 38 needed.
How many girls played high school sports by 1978, up from 300,000 in 1972?

notes: 15 cards: 6 law or case to significance, 4 person, 3 figure, 1 organisation, 1 cloze. Dropped the Miss America protest and Ms. sales figure as flavour.
